name: My First CEO Bot
tagline: A personal chief of staff for your first years on your own
description: Holds your task list, dates and appointments together in a single spot, then sends a short rundown each day or each week of what is coming next. Anything outside its lane gets pointed to a bot better suited to it, so life admin stops piling up in one inbox. The cadence is your choice and the setup stays plain.
author: gilman_trevor
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
